weights_note: Analytical weights, not a player-facing exchange rate; fixed before validation.

economic_gate.scope: Full personal-mission payout including bonus and per-type rounding; all-in is a separate unchanged mode.
economic_gate.model: Whole-route optimal expected payout, uniform independent rolls/offers, optional evacuation; no seed or future route.
economic_gate.statistical_rule: Every case: upper endpoint of its 95% interval and exact model bound must be <= limit. Intervals are per-case, not simultaneous.
